name: Neuschwanstein Castle
description: New Swan Stone Castle (English: New Swan Stone Castle, German: Schloss Neuschwanstein), full name New Swan Stone Castle, is a late 19th-century building located in the southwest of Bavaria, Germany, adjacent to the earlier Schloss Hohenschwangau (also known as Old Swan Castle). It is about 4 kilometers away from the town of Fussen and not far from the border between Germany and Austria.
